deadline.value: No overall deadline; the department advises having your application ready by early December to keep funding options open (Mathematical & Theoretical Physics studentships: applications by 1 January).
deadline.quote: There is no overall deadline to apply for Research Degrees, but many funding opportunities have early application deadlines. | aim to have your degree application ready for submission by early December

supervisor.value: You name a potential supervisor on the application, which does not commit you; contacting supervisors first is recommended.
supervisor.quote: We recommend contacting potential supervisors before submitting your application to discuss your research interests and whether they have a suitable project.

funding.value: The department offers a number of funded studentships each year, and also accepts self-funded and externally funded students.
funding.quote: Each year, the Department offers a number of funded positions and welcomes applications from highly motivated and talented candidates.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants are normally expected to hold an integrated Master's or a Master's with merit; a high first-class Bachelor's only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for the PhD in Mathematical Sciences are normally expected to have at least an upper second-class integrated Master's degree (such as an MMath) or a merit in a postgraduate Master's degree. | In exceptional cases, applicants with a high first-class Bachelor's degree may also be considered.
